title: Delivery
description: v0.4 (convert-anyway: per-program assurance, top-level convertAnyway, repoMaxUsd and spentUsd; old records stay valid) (v0.3 target optional: a visitor's import keeps its results on the site; adds public and per-program reason). A migration from a legacy GitHub repository to a pull request on a target repository, as served by services/api GET /deliveries/{id}. Updated while it runs.

target.description: Repository that receives the pull request; null for an import whose results stay on the site

precheck.description: Visitor imports only: the compile-only check of the original programs (contracts/compile-check.schema.json). checked = programs asked; stopped = why the check ended early (sandbox busy or unreachable, time or count bound) or null; notes = fixed phrases only (never output of a subprocess, the sandbox or a program; raw details stay in the server-side deliver.log).

run.description: Live summary of the converter run: status, stage, recent events, efficiency so far

costUsd.description: Convert-anyway: this program's estimated model spend (null: no price known)

assurance.description: Convert-anyway mode: what the verifier could and could not show. Only `certified` is certified; status stays not-certified for the others. The run record has the details.

reason.description: Why a program was skipped (for example: over the line limit for visitor imports)

public.description: Started by a visitor without the admin passcode (sandboxed, capped, never opens a pull request)

convertAnyway.description: Convert-anyway mode was on (admin path or local CLI only, never a visitor import): programs that would be refused are translated and compile-checked, and labelled by assurance

repoMaxUsd.description: REPO_MAX_USD: hard cap on model spend across all programs of this delivery (convert-anyway mode)

spentUsd.description: Model spend so far across the programs of this delivery (estimated, list prices; null if a model has no known price)

request.description: POST /deliveries body. With the admin passcode: any allowed target, pull request opened. Without it (a visitor): legacy only, any public GitHub repository, sandboxed and capped; results stay on the site.

target.description: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> that receives the pull request (admin only)

convertAnyway.description: Admin only: a visitor request that sets it is refused (403)
